How it works

Twelve denominators. Forty-six distinct moments.

Equivalent fractions land on the same milestone, so 1/2, 2/4, and 6/12 are counted once. Twelfth-aligned markers stay on the second day of their month. The rest fall into the calendar day containing their exact position between one anniversary and the next—without tracking a time.
